timeslots.pattern_disclaimer: General North Indian winter inversion pattern (not a local forecast): air is usually heaviest in early morning and late evening, and slightly lighter between 1 pm and 4 pm.
timeslots.hourly_note: Based on modelled hourly PM2.5 for the next 24 hours; actual street-level readings can vary.
timeslots.early_morning.moderate: Cool morning air often traps dust and smoke near the ground. Check the AQI before brisk outdoor walks.
timeslots.early_morning.high: Winter inversion traps the heaviest smog before sunrise. Keep morning walks and exercise indoors today.
timeslots.school_work_run.moderate: Road traffic peaks during school and office hours. Choose side streets over heavy main roads where you can.
timeslots.school_work_run.high: Traffic exhaust mixes with trapped morning smog. Wear a fitted N95 mask outside and keep car windows shut on recirculate.
timeslots.midday.moderate: Midday sunlight usually lifts trapped smog slightly. Good window to air out rooms briefly and run outdoor errands.
timeslots.midday.high: Air is still polluted, though often lighter than morning or night. Keep any necessary outdoor errands short and air rooms only for 10 to 15 minutes if outdoor air eases.
timeslots.evening.moderate: Temperatures drop after sunset and smoke begins settling again. Close windows early and turn on the kitchen exhaust while cooking.
timeslots.evening.high: Keep windows and balcony doors shut from early evening. Move children's play indoors and avoid incense or indoor burning.
timeslots.night.moderate: Keep sleeping rooms dust-free with wet mopping done earlier in the day and close street-facing windows.
timeslots.night.high: Nighttime inversion holds smog low until morning. Seal door gaps, run your purifier or supervised fan-filter in the bedroom, and keep windows closed.
action.noTimelineItems: No specific extra step needed in this slot beyond the guidance above.

footer.credits: Air quality and city data: Open-Meteo (modelled data, not ground CPCB monitors). Language personalisation when enabled: Google Gemini.
footer.disclaimer: AirWise offers practical air-quality guidance and approximate estimates, not medical advice. If anyone in your home has trouble breathing, wheezing, chest tightness, or worsening symptoms, contact a doctor.
fallback.headline.Good: Air is relatively clear today; keep simple clean-air habits going
fallback.headline.Satisfactory: Air is satisfactory today; watch morning and evening smoke
fallback.headline.Moderate: Moderate smog today; time your outdoor hours carefully
fallback.headline.Poor: Poor air today; protect lungs outdoors and seal indoor rooms
fallback.headline.Very Poor: Very Poor air today; stay indoors during peak smog hours
fallback.headline.Severe: Severe smog today; stay indoors and protect sensitive family members
fallback.summary.standard: Follow the cleaner afternoon window for errands, keep evening indoor air closed and smoke-free, and cut tailpipe and burning smoke where you can.
fallback.summary.elevated: Because children, older adults, or sensitive members live in your home, keep outdoor exposure short, close windows by early evening, and rely on wet cleaning indoors.
fallback.summary.high: Today's air poses a heavy load for sensitive lungs. Keep outdoor trips strictly essential with a fitted N95 mask, keep one sleeping room well sealed, and watch for breathing symptoms.
fallback.familyTip.standard: Check the AQI once at 7 am and once at 1 pm before deciding when to open windows or step out.
fallback.familyTip.elevated: Keep fitted N95 masks near the front door so children and older family members never have to search for one.
fallback.familyTip.high: Keep regular inhalers or prescribed medicines within reach, and check in with a doctor promptly if coughing or wheezing worsens.

action.seek_medical_care_if_symptoms: Keep prescribed inhalers or medicines handy, and seek medical care promptly if anyone develops wheezing, breathlessness, or chest tightness.
impact.seek_medical_care_if_symptoms: Early medical care can help reduce the risk of a severe flare-up during Poor to Severe smog days.
action.shift_outdoor_exercise: Shift outdoor walks or runs from early morning to mid-afternoon when trapped smoke lifts slightly.
impact.shift_outdoor_exercise: Exercising during cleaner hours can help reduce how many fine particles you breathe deeply into your lungs.
action.move_exercise_indoors: Move morning walks, yoga, and workouts indoors today instead of exercising in heavy smog.
impact.move_exercise_indoors: Heavy breathing outdoors pulls fine PM2.5 deeper into the lungs; staying inside can help reduce that exposure.
action.check_aqi_before_school_run: Check the AQI reading before the morning school run or walk so you know whether masks are needed.
impact.check_aqi_before_school_run: A quick check helps you adjust outdoor time and masks before stepping into peak morning smog.
action.wear_n95_outdoors: Wear a properly fitted N95 or FFP2 mask outdoors; pinch the nose clip tight (cloth and surgical masks filter far less).
impact.wear_n95_outdoors: A well-sealed N95 mask is lab-rated to filter at least 95% of test particles and can help reduce outdoor intake, though fit matters.
action.avoid_heavy_traffic_routes: Walk or wait on quieter side lanes rather than standing beside idling traffic on main roads.
impact.avoid_heavy_traffic_routes: Particle levels spike right next to tailpipes; stepping one lane away can help reduce short-term exposure.
action.use_recirculate_in_car: Keep car windows rolled up and set the AC to cabin recirculate mode on smoggy roads.
impact.use_recirculate_in_car: Recirculate mode cuts the amount of outside exhaust entering the cabin; crack a window briefly on long drives to avoid CO2 buildup.
action.batch_errands_midday: Combine grocery, pharmacy, and bank errands into one short midday trip instead of multiple morning and evening trips.
impact.batch_errands_midday: Fewer trips during cleaner afternoon hours can help reduce both your exposure time and local vehicle emissions.
action.limit_children_outdoor_play: Keep children's outdoor play short today and switch active games indoors when smog is Poor or worse.
impact.limit_children_outdoor_play: Children breathe faster per kilogram of body weight; shorter outdoor play on heavy smog days can help reduce their particle intake.
action.rinse_face_after_commute: Wash hands and face, and rinse your nose with plain saline water after returning from a smoggy commute.
impact.rinse_face_after_commute: Washing off settled dust and soot can help reduce nose and throat irritation after time on the road.
action.timed_window_ventilation: Keep windows shut during heavy morning and evening smog, and open them for 10 to 15 minutes around midday when outdoor air is lightest.
impact.timed_window_ventilation: Brief midday airing clears stale indoor air without letting peak inversion smog flood the rooms.
action.close_windows_evening_night: Close windows and balcony doors by 6 pm before cool evening air traps smoke close to the ground.
impact.close_windows_evening_night: Closing up before evening inversion starts can help reduce indoor PM2.5 climbing overnight.
action.seal_door_window_gaps: Fit inexpensive foam draught strips or place a rolled damp towel along the bottom gap of exterior doors.
impact.seal_door_window_gaps: Blocking visible gaps slows outdoor smog from drifting inside overnight.
action.run_hepa_purifier: Run your HEPA air purifier in the room where the family spends the most time (and the bedroom at night), and vacuum the pre-filter weekly.
impact.run_hepa_purifier: A right-sized True HEPA filter in a closed room can help reduce indoor PM2.5 steadily over the evening and night.
action.diy_box_fan_filter: As a low-cost stopgap without a purifier, tape a MERV-13 or HEPA filter snugly to the back of a box fan and run it only while supervised.
impact.diy_box_fan_filter: This stopgap fan-filter can help reduce indoor dust and smoke particles, but use it supervised, keep it away from water, and check that the motor stays cool.
action.wet_mop_no_dry_sweep: Wet-mop floors and wipe surfaces with a damp cloth instead of dry broom sweeping or feather dusting.
impact.wet_mop_no_dry_sweep: Dry sweeping kicks settled fine dust right back into the air your family breathes; wet mopping traps it.
action.avoid_incense_candles: Skip agarbatti, dhoop, scented candles, mosquito coils, and any indoor burning on polluted days.
impact.avoid_incense_candles: Even one stick of incense or a mosquito coil releases concentrated indoor PM2.5 in a closed room.
action.run_kitchen_exhaust: Switch on the kitchen chimney or exhaust fan (or open the kitchen window briefly) whenever frying or tadka creates smoke.
impact.run_kitchen_exhaust: Venting cooking fumes right at the stove can help reduce sharp indoor PM2.5 spikes in the rest of the house.
action.keep_bedroom_clean_zone: Set up one well-sealed bedroom as a cleaner sleeping room for children, elderly members, or anyone with breathing sensitivity.
impact.keep_bedroom_clean_zone: Keeping one room tightly closed gives lungs 7 to 8 calmer hours overnight.
action.indoor_plants_realistic_note: Keep indoor plants if you enjoy them, but remember houseplants do not meaningfully purify room air during smog.
impact.indoor_plants_realistic_note: Knowing plants are decorative helps you focus effort on steps that actually lower indoor particles, like sealing gaps and timed ventilation.
action.switch_to_metro_or_bus: Take the metro, city bus, or shared ride instead of driving alone on days when the route works for you.
impact.switch_to_metro_or_bus: Moving trips from a private car or scooter to metro or bus can help reduce daily tailpipe emissions and road dust.
action.carpool_school_office: Share the school or office car run with one or two neighbouring families on the same route.
impact.carpool_school_office: Cutting one car trip in half reduces fuel spend and tailpipe smoke right around your colony and school gate.
action.walk_cycle_short_trips: On Good to Moderate days, walk or cycle for short neighbourhood errands under 2 km away from busy main roads.
impact.walk_cycle_short_trips: Replacing short cold-engine vehicle starts cuts high per-kilometre exhaust smoke near homes.
action.switch_clean_cooking_fuel: Transition from wood, biomass, or kerosene stoves to LPG or electric induction cooking wherever possible (check Ujjwala or local subsidy options).
impact.switch_clean_cooking_fuel: Switching away from solid or kerosene fuels can help reduce heavy indoor smoke right where the family cooks and eats.
action.no_waste_leaf_burning: Never burn dry leaves, garden clippings, or household trash; compost leaves or hand them to municipal collection.
impact.no_waste_leaf_burning: Open leaf and garbage fires release dense local PM2.5 that lingers in the street all evening.
action.avoid_diesel_generator: Avoid running small diesel generators during power cuts; use inverter-battery backup or discuss shared cleaner backup with your RWA.
impact.avoid_diesel_generator: Diesel generators emit concentrated soot right at ground level inside residential blocks.
action.engine_off_at_red_lights: Switch off your vehicle engine at red lights and railway crossings when waiting longer than 20 seconds.
impact.engine_off_at_red_lights: Cutting idle time saves fuel and reduces concentrated exhaust clouds at crowded intersections.
action.combine_deliveries_work_remote: Batch online deliveries into fewer drop-offs and work from home when your workplace permits on heavy smog days.
impact.combine_deliveries_work_remote: Fewer daily road trips lower both personal traffic exposure and neighbourhood tailpipe emissions.
action.report_open_burning: Report open garbage, leaf, or construction-waste burning to your municipal helpline or the official CPCB Sameer app.
impact.report_open_burning: Prompt civic reporting helps stop local smoke hotspots that affect entire colonies overnight.
action.organize_rwa_school_smog_plan: Suggest a simple winter smog plan with your RWA or school: staggered drop-offs, no waste burning, and covered construction sand.
impact.organize_rwa_school_smog_plan: Coordinated colony rules can help reduce local dust and idling smoke far more than one household acting alone.
action.check_on_elderly_neighbours: Call or check in on elderly or homebound neighbours on Very Poor and Severe days to help with groceries or pharmacy runs.
impact.check_on_elderly_neighbours: Helping older neighbours avoid stepping out during severe smog can help reduce their exposure.
action.share_weekly_family_plan: Print a one-page summary of today's guidance for the apartment notice board or share it on your colony WhatsApp group.
impact.share_weekly_family_plan: Clear, calm instructions help neighbours skip myths and adopt practical clean-air habits together.
action.request_water_sprinkling_dust_con: Ask your RWA or ward office to cover loose construction material and wet-clean dusty colony lanes instead of dry sweeping.
impact.request_water_sprinkling_dust_con: Keeping road and construction dust damp can help reduce coarse PM10 clouds blowing into ground-floor homes.
action.advocate_no_idling_school_gate: Encourage parents and school vans to switch off engines while waiting outside the school gate.
impact.advocate_no_idling_school_gate: Stopping engine idling at school gates lowers exhaust right at children's breathing height.
